purpose: Teach: 夜明け/粘土/鴨/ピエロ/根っこ/裾/根気/生意気

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、夜明けまで、ゲーム、やったことある?
lines.en: Riku, have you ever gamed all night until dawn?
lines.style: Casual, genuinely curious. Leans in slightly, eyes bright. Testing whether he'll actually answer or deflect. Warm underneath the surface question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。図工の時間、粘土、めっちゃ楽しいよな。
lines.en: Yeah. Though honestly, art class with clay is way more fun.
lines.style: Slight smile in the voice. Relaxed, a little self-aware. Not quite meeting her energy but matching it. Comfortable tangent.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 池の鴨、子供たちに人気だね、最近の公園。
lines.en: You know, those ducks at the pond have gotten really popular with kids lately.
lines.style: Softer now, slightly dreamy. Drawing back into her own observation. Not quite a non-sequitur—she's thinking. Gentle pace, like she's noticing out loud.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、お前、ピエロの衣装で出るんだろ?
lines.en: So you're actually going through with the clown costume at the festival, huh?
lines.style: Wry, half-teasing. Slight smirk underneath. Testing her commitment. Not unkind, but definitely amused at her expense.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 植木の根っこ、ガーデニング部、整えてたよ、昨日。
lines.en: Yeah, the gardening club was out there yesterday fixing up all the plant roots.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, a little animated when she mentions the work. Not defensive about the club—just stating fact. Then settling back, slightly deflecting his question with her own topic.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 制服のズボンの裾、ちょっと、長いんだよな、お前のはどう?
lines.en: Your uniform pants are a bit long, aren't they? Mine's fine.
lines.style: Quick, deflecting back at him with the same wry energy he used. Slight bite of humor. Not mean, but definitely turning it around. Keeping pace with his teasing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、根気よく、続けるしかないよね、リク。
lines.en: You just have to keep pushing through with club activities, Riku. No way around it.
lines.style: More earnest now, softer. Looking at him directly—not teasing anymore. Genuinely serious but still kind. The voice of someone who knows about patience because she practices it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、たまに、生意気な口、きくよな。
lines.en: You can be pretty cheeky yourself sometimes, you know that?
lines.style: Light, unbothered response. Small laugh underneath. Not offended—turning it back on him again with easy confidence. The comfort of someone who knows they can trade jabs.
